Therefore, if `id` is not a valid integer, a `NumberFormatException` will be thrown, and this is not avoided by any checks in the provided code.
remark: The `NumberFormatException` will be thrown if the `id` is not a valid integer, i.e., if it contains any non-numeric characters (excluding the first character being a plus or minus sign) or if it is an empty string.
